title: 第196章  揍我的人是你吧？
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
谢莲心抬起了一只手，一朵如同雾气般的莲花就出现在了她的手中。
那莲花朝着太一飞去，接着释放出了更多的雾气，将谢莲心和太一都笼罩在了一起。谢莲心靠近了被锁链束缚的男人，她伸出白皙的双臂搂着男人的脖子，在他耳边轻轻地道：“让我来看看你的梦境……”
她的声音很轻很轻。
她轻轻地用自己的额头抵在他的额上，闭上了那一双紫色的眼眸。
她进入了一个空白的世界里。
这世界里什么都没有。
谢莲心愣住了。
过了好一会儿之后，她退出了这梦境。
谢莲心低头深思，怎么会什么都没有呢？就算是失忆了，他作为天极门的天才修士太一也该有自己的梦境吧？
她挥手间，一道银白色流光自远处而来，落入她的手中变成了一把银白色的长剑。
这长剑正是无咎剑。
谢莲心看看手中的剑，又看看太一。
剑灵沉睡，这家伙又一副失忆的样子，黑天帝不知所踪……
烦死了！
谢莲心烦躁地啧了一声。
————
太一醒来的时候，发现自己在一处陌生的房间里面。这房间里垂着浅金色的帷幔，还挂着珠帘，周围的摆设带有女子的特征。这房间看似是女子的闺房。
他坐起身来，感觉头还有点痛。
不过一会儿，看到珠帘后面出现了一道身影，接着就看到了一袭白衣的谢莲心进来了。黑发紫瞳的少女穿白纱衣的样子，圣洁而美丽，如同是远古的女神降临一般。她笑吟吟地道：“你醒来了啊。”
太一看着谢莲心问道：“我怎么在这里？我之前分明再跟一个黑袍人交手的，那黑袍人……”

谢莲心道：“那家伙已经被我杀了。”
“被你杀了？”太一震惊地看着她，过了半晌，又问道，“你到底是什么人？”
“我呀，我就是个普普通通的隐士高人。”谢莲心笑道。
太一：“……你能正经一点吗？”
谢莲心看他严肃起来，收敛了笑容，她道：“我不叫羲和。”
“猜到了。”
“我叫谢莲心。”
太一听到这个名字后，似乎有点印象，他轻轻地念了一声，“谢莲心……”
“对，我叫谢莲心。”
谢莲心坐在了床沿边，整理了一下自己乌黑的秀发，有看着太一的眼睛。她道：“你听到我的名字之后，有想起什么来吗？”
太一摇摇头：“虽然没有想起什么，但觉得有点熟悉。”
“帝俊、黑天帝、刑渊、灵威仰、祝融、共工、地母……”谢莲心念了一连串上古初代神灵的名字，然后问道，“听到这些名字，有没有什么熟悉感？”
太一道：“这些不就是远古神话中的上古神明吗？当然有熟悉感了。”
谢莲心：“不是那种熟悉感。”
太一问道：“那是什么熟悉感？”
“你记得自己是怎么到天极门的吗？”谢莲心问。
“是师父把我捡回去的。”
“在那之前呢？”
“我当时是个婴儿，我怎么知道？”
“你变成婴儿之前，你是天帝帝俊。”谢莲心认真地道。

她说完这话之后，见太一震惊地看着她，一副不敢置信的样子。
“我，天帝？”
谢莲心重重地点头。
谢莲心站起身来，就将事情原原本本地说了一遍。她说完之后，看到太一呆愣地望着她，显然对于她说的一切都感觉难以置信。
“总之就是，我也不知道你怎么跟黑天帝分开了，也不知道你怎么就失忆了，反正你就是天帝。怎么样？听完了我说的这些，你有没有想起一点什么？”谢莲心问道。
银发金瞳的男人低着头，似是深思了起来，过了好一会儿，他才道：“你说的这些，让人很难以置信。”
“没关系，你可以慢慢地消化。”谢莲心道。
太一看着她：“如果我真是天帝，你为什么一开始不告诉我？”
谢莲心：“我哪里知道你是真的失忆，还是假失忆的。”
太一又问：“那你现在又为什么告诉我了？”
谢莲心说：“因为你看着好像真的失忆了。”
太一定定地看了她几眼，问：“之前揍我的黑袍人是你吧？”
谢莲心囧：“……”
这都被你猜出来了？
她当然是不会认的，立刻就转身过去，哈哈了几声：“想太多了你。”谢莲心说着心虚地走出去了。
谢莲心走出外面，外面景色清幽。她沿着小石子路，走到了花树下。这里摆着石桌子和石凳子。谢莲心在石凳子上坐下，挥手间，这石桌子上就多了茶水和点心。
不过一会儿，太一就从里面出来了。
他朝着谢莲心走去，走到了谢莲心旁边的时候，环视四周，问道：“这里是哪里？”
“这里是仙界。”谢莲心端着茶杯说。
太一惊诧：“仙界？仙界不是早就已经毁灭了吗？”

“我重建的。”谢莲心冲着太一一下。
弥生界跟外部隔绝太久了，所以太一完全不知道仙界已经重建了。他此刻望着四周，神识散开去。只见一座座仙山仙岛释放出浓郁至极的仙道气韵，大大小小的城池中到处都是修士的身影。
“这仙界重建了也就一百多年而已，你可以将你的师门搬到这里来。这里更适合人类修士修炼。你那个师尊已经是渡劫期，他若是进入这仙界，不过三年就能成仙。”谢莲心懒懒地摘着葡萄说，她将一颗葡萄扔进了嘴里。
太一看着谢莲心道：“那真是多谢你了。”
虽然谢莲心说他是天帝，但他现在没有一点实感。在他心里，他还是天极门的太一。
谢莲心看着太一的眉眼，忽然地站起来，她一只手伸出，手中就多了一把银白色的神剑。她握着那把无咎剑，举到了太一的面前，示意让他接。
太一只是扫了无咎剑一眼，瞳孔就骤然收缩了一下，这剑……
“这是你的剑。”谢莲心道。
太一看看她的脸，慢慢地伸出手去，他握住了无咎剑。在他握住无咎剑的瞬间，无咎剑就发出白色的光芒。接着就看到了沉睡的剑灵出现了，剑灵一出现，就朝着太一靠近，跟太一融为了一体。
太一长发飞扬，衣袍飞舞，全身释放出圣洁白光。
然后——
他就两眼一闭，倒下了。
谢莲心立即就接住了太一。
开满了鲜花的柔软草地上，银发的俊美男子靠着白衣少女的肩膀，仿佛是沉睡了过去。少女扶着男人，着急地道：“喂喂，喂喂……你醒醒啊，你快醒醒啊！喂——”
content_en:
Xie Lianxin raised a hand, and a mist-like lotus appeared in her hand.
The lotus flew towards Taiyi, and then released more mist, shrouding Xie Lianxin and Taiyi together. Xie Lianxin approached the man who was bound by chains. She stretched out her fair arms around the man's neck and whispered in his ear: "Let me see your dream..."
Her voice was very soft.
She gently pressed her forehead against his and closed her purple eyes.
She entered a blank world.
There is nothing in this world.
Xie Lianxin was stunned.
After a while, she exited the dream.
Xie Lianxin lowered her head and thought deeply, how could there be nothing? Even if he has lost his memory, as the genius monk Taiyi of Tianji Sect, he should have his own dreams, right?
As she waved her hand, a silver-white stream of light came from a distance, fell into her hand and turned into a silver-white long sword.
This long sword is the Wujiu Sword.
Xie Lianxin looked at the sword in her hand and then at Taiyi.
The sword spirit is sleeping, this guy looks like he has lost his memory again, and the Black Heaven Emperor is nowhere to be found...
So annoying!
Xie Lian clicked her tongue irritably.
————
When Taiyi woke up, he found himself in a strange room. There are light golden curtains and beaded curtains hanging in this room, and the surrounding furnishings have female characteristics. This room looks like a woman's boudoir.
He sat up, feeling his head hurt.
But after a while, I saw a figure appearing behind the bead curtain, and then I saw Xie Lianxin in white clothes coming in. The girl with black hair and purple eyes looks holy and beautiful in white gauze, as if she is the arrival of an ancient goddess. She smiled and said: "You're awake."
Taiyi looked at Xie Lianxin and asked: "Why am I here? I clearly fought with a man in black robe before. That man in black robe..."
Xie Lian thought: "I have already killed that guy."
"Killed by you?" Taiyi looked at her in shock. After a while, he asked again, "Who are you?"
"Me, I'm just an ordinary hermit master." Xie Lianxin said with a smile.
Taiyi: "...can you be more serious?"
Xie Lianxin saw that he had become serious and stopped smiling. She said, "My name is not Xihe."
"Guessed it."
"My name is Xie Lianxin."
After Taiyi heard the name, he seemed to have some impression. He said softly, "Thank you Lianxin..."
"Yes, my name is Xie Lianxin."
Xie Lianxin sat on the edge of the bed, straightened her black hair, and looked into Taiyi's eyes. She said: "Did you think of anything after hearing my name?"
Taiyi shook his head: "Although I didn't think of anything, it felt a bit familiar."
"Dijun, Heitian Emperor, Xingyuan, Lingweiyang, Zhurong, Gonggong, Earth Mother..." Xie Lian recited a series of names of the first ancient gods in her heart, and then asked, "Do you feel familiar when you hear these names?"
Taidao: "Aren't these the ancient gods in ancient mythology? Of course they feel familiar."
Xie Lianxin: "It's not that familiar feeling."
Taiyi asked: "What kind of familiarity is that?"
"Do you remember how you got to Tianjimen?" Xie Lianxin asked.
"Master picked me back up."
"What about before that?"
"I was a baby, how would I know?"
"Before you became a baby, you were the Emperor of Heaven." Xie Lianxin said seriously.
After she said this, she saw Taiyi looking at her in shock and disbelief.
"Me, the Emperor of Heaven?"
Xie Lian nodded heartily.
Xie Lianxin stood up and told the story exactly. After she finished speaking, she saw Taiyi staring at her blankly, obviously feeling unbelievable about everything she said.
"In short, I don't know how you separated from Emperor Heitian.I don’t know why you lost your memory. Anyway, you are the Emperor of Heaven. How about it? After listening to what I said, did you remember anything? "Xie Lianxin asked.
The man with silver hair and golden eyes lowered his head, seeming to be deep in thought. After a while, he said: "What you said is unbelievable. "
"It's okay, you can digest it slowly. "Xie Lianxin said.
Taiyi looked at her: "If I was really the Emperor of Heaven, why didn't you tell me in the first place? "
Xie Lianxin: "How do I know if you really have amnesia or if you are pretending to have amnesia. "
Taiyi asked again: "Then why did you tell me now? "
Xie Lianxin said: "Because you seem to have really lost your memory. "
Tai looked at her intently and asked, "Were you the man in black robe who beat me up before? "
Xie Lian felt embarrassed: "..."
Have you guessed this?
Of course she wouldn't admit it, so she immediately turned around and laughed a few times: "I've thought about you too much. Xie Lianxin said and walked out with a guilty conscience.
Xie Lianxin walked outside. The scenery outside was quiet. She walked along the gravel path and walked under the flower tree. There are stone tables and stone stools here. Xie Lianxin sat down on the stone stool, and with a wave of her hand, there was tea and snacks on the stone table.
After a while, Taiyi came out.
He walked towards Xie Lianxin, and when he came to Xie Lianxin's side, he looked around and asked, "Where is this place? "
"This is fairyland. "Xie Lianxin said while holding the tea cup.
Taiyi was surprised: "Immortal world? Hasn’t the fairy world been destroyed long ago? "
“I rebuilt it. "Xie Lianxin pointed at Taiyi.
The Yayoi world has been isolated from the outside world for too long, so Taichi has no idea that the fairy world has been rebuilt. He was looking around now, his consciousness spreading out. I saw fairy mountains and islands emitting a rich and extremely rich fairy spirit, and monks were everywhere in cities of all sizes.
"This fairy world has only been rebuilt for more than a hundred years. You can move your master here. This place is more suitable for human monks to practice. Your master is already in the stage of transcending tribulation. If he enters this immortal world, he will become an immortal in just three years. Xie Lianxin said while picking grapes lazily. She threw a grape into her mouth.
Taiyi looked at Xie Lian and said in his heart: "Thank you very much. "
Although Xie Lianxin said that he was the Emperor of Heaven, he has no real feeling now. In his heart, he is still the Taiyi of Tianji Sect.
Xie Lianxin looked at Taiyi's eyebrows and suddenly stood up. She stretched out one hand, and there was a silver-white divine sword in her hand. She held the blameless sword and raised it in front of Tai Yi, gesturing for him to take it.
Taiyi glanced at Wujiu Sword, and his pupils suddenly shrank. This sword...
"This is your sword. "Xie Lianxin said.
Taiyi looked at her face and slowly stretched out his hand, holding the Wujiu Sword. The moment he held the Wujiu Sword, the Wujiu Sword glowed white. Then he saw the sleeping sword spirit appear. As soon as the sword spirit appeared, it approached Taiyi and merged with Taiyi.
Taiyi's long hair flew, his robes fluttered, and his whole body released holy white light.
Then——
He closed his eyes and fell down.
Xie Lianxin immediately caught Taiyi.
On the soft grass full of flowers, the handsome silver-haired man leaned on the shoulder of the girl in white, seeming to have fallen asleep. The girl supported the man and said anxiously: "Hey, hey, hey... wake up, wake up quickly! Hello--"
